dashboard.subtitle: Here’s what changed on requests you follow. Your profile never decides whether you can donate — staff at the facility do.
dashboard.noUpdates: No updates yet. Save a request to follow its status.
dashboard.noRecent: Requests you open in the Explorer appear here. This list stays on this device.

guidance.title: Before you visit a desk
guidance.id: Mention the request ID (e.g. BM-2026-0012) so staff can match you.
guidance.hours: Check desk hours on the request — they can change.
guidance.screening: Staff will screen you on-site. Follow their guidance on eligibility.
guidance.place: Go only to the listed coordination point, never a private address.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Updates on requests you save or submit.
notifications.empty: You don’t have any notifications yet.
notifications.emptyBody: Save a request to follow its status. We’ll show updates here — saving doesn’t commit you to anything.

saved.title: Saved requests
saved.subtitle: Saved requests are private to you. We’ll notify you when one changes status, is updated, or is about to expire.
saved.caption: Saved requests
saved.note: Inactive requests stay here for 30 days so you can see how they ended, then they’re removed automatically. Use ⋯ to remove one now.

activity.title: My activity
activity.subtitle: Everything you’ve done in BloodMap. Only you and authorized administrators (for security reviews) can see this.

profile.title: Profile and preferences
profile.subtitle: Control what you share, how we contact you, and your account security.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Basic information used to sign in.
account.name: Full name
account.editBody: If you change your email, we’ll send a link to verify the new address.

visibility.title: Who can see what
visibility.subtitle: BloodMap only collects what it needs. Nothing about you is ever shown on public pages.
visibility.note: Your contact details are only used for the notifications you choose. They’re never shared with requesters or facilities.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Email only in this version. You can turn any of these off at any time.
notifications.status: Email me when a saved request changes status
notifications.expiry: Remind me 6 hours before a saved request expires
notifications.weekly: Weekly summary of active requests in my area

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: These settings only affect what happens on this device and in your account.
privacy.location: Use my location to sort requests by distance (this device only, never stored)
privacy.recent: Keep a list of requests I’ve recently viewed

security.title: Sessions & security
security.changeBody: You’ll be signed out on other devices after the change.

close.title: Close account
close.subtitle: Choose what fits — you can come back after deactivating, but deletion can’t be undone.
close.deactivateBody: Hides your account and stops all emails. Sign in again within 90 days to restore it.
close.deleteBody: Saved requests and preferences are erased within 30 days. Security log entries are kept for 1 year with your name removed.
close.dialogBody: This permanently removes your saved requests, preferences and notification settings within 30 days. You won’t be able to recover them.
close.mismatch: Type your account email exactly to confirm.
